_comment: The logistics schema that used to be the library default. Measured against real SWE-agent trajectories it produced 75 facts of which every sampled one was prose matched by accident. Kept here as an opt-in example, with the measurement that condemns it.

destination_address: (?:deliver to|bring it to|change (?:the )?(?:address|destination) to|my address is|come to|new address:?|confirmed as|destination is|actually (?:use|send (?:it|them) to)|reroute (?:the rider )?to|use)\s+([A-Za-z0-9\s,–#-]{4,40}?)(?:\.|\,|$|\bwith\b|\band\b|\bplease\b|\bfor\b)
